title: Against All Odds

cues.en: How can I just let you walk away?
cues.zh: 我怎能就這樣眼睜睜看著你轉身離去？
cues.text: How can I just let you walk away?

cues.en: Just let you leave without a trace
cues.zh: 讓你毫無痕跡地離開

cues.en: You're the only one who really knew me at all

cues.en: And there's nothin' left here to remind me

cues.en: Just the memory of your face
cues.zh: 只是你臉上的記憶

cues.text: Ooh, take a look at me now, well there's just an empty space

cues.en: And you coming back to me is against the odds
cues.zh: 而你回到我身邊是相當困難的
cues.text: And you coming back to me is against the odds

cues.en: And that's what I've got to face
cues.zh: 這就是我必須面對的

cues.zh: 轉身看我哭泣
cues.text: Turn around and see me cry
